title: Fix the Racy Singleton
summary: A lazily initialised ID generator hands out duplicate IDs under load. Make both the initialisation and the counter thread-safe.
hints: There are **two** races: two threads can both see `instance == null`, and `counter++` is a read-modify-write.
Java: the holder idiom (`private static class Holder { static final IdGenerator I = new IdGenerator(); }`) fixes initialisation for free. `AtomicLong` fixes the counter.
Go: `sync.Once` for the instance, `atomic.Int64` (or a mutex) for the counter.
